card.name: Spots just before a new section starts
card.fires_on: Marks the last piece of a drug name, number or reference just before a new heading, bullet or list item begins in label text. Examples are the end of a drug name before its description, or a closing bracket before a section number.

modes.label: End of a drug name
modes.description: Final piece of a drug or drug class name right before the text about it begins.
modes.example: Sympathomim<<etics>> Metolazone may decrease arterial responsiveness

modes.label: Closing citation or sentence end
modes.description: A closing bracket or period ending a cross-reference or sentence just before a numbered section heading.

modes.label: Inside dose or figure labels
modes.description: A number, unit or slash within a dosing table or figure label.

card.writes: It pushes toward symbols that start a new item, such as bullets, brackets and numbered headings, and away from blank spacing characters.
card.plain: It fires at the point where one entry in a drug label ends and a new heading or bullet is about to begin.
